facts.quote: Graza started Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) but also made sure to get into grocers like Whole Foods, Target, etc.
Graza’s social content, product design, and messaging are playful and culinary-inspired rather than overly formal.
Dickieson estimated that Graza has added around 2,000 new social followers since launching the cans.

parsed.subject: Graza's Social Content Story
parsed.body:
Hi Graza team,

We're reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on the information we've gathered about your brand. We believe a post that highlights your playful and culinary-inspired approach would resonate well with your audience. The post would feature Graza's unique social content, product design, and messaging in a way that feels authentic and engaging. It would also showcase your playful tone, as Dickieson estimates around 2,000 new social followers since your launch. This post would be a great way to further amplify your brand's voice and engagement with your target demographic. It's about celebrating your creativity and the joy of olive oil in a fun, visual way.

The BrandPilot team
